subject.title: Telegram: apiRoot local Bot API server receives updates but never dispatches to agent sessions

question: Should Telegram update-offset identity include the normalized apiRoot, should doctor/setup reset offsets on apiRoot changes, and should a 400 Logged out deleteWebhook response during local Bot API migration be treated as non-fatal?
rationale: The fix changes persisted channel state and startup failure tolerance, which affects replay/drop behavior and when OpenClaw should fail closed versus keep polling.

options.title: Endpoint-aware offset identity
options.body: Store normalized apiRoot identity with the offset and reset or ignore stale offsets when account, token, or endpoint identity changes, with tests for official-to-local migration.

options.title: Doctor-only reset
options.body: Keep runtime offset keys account/token-scoped but add a doctor/setup repair that detects apiRoot changes and clears the stale offset before polling.

options.title: Document manual reset only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document that users must clear the Telegram offset when switching Bot API roots, accepting a higher support burden.

recommendation.title: Endpoint-aware offset identity
recommendation.body: Store normalized apiRoot identity with the offset and reset or ignore stale offsets when account, token, or endpoint identity changes, with tests for official-to-local migration.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame places the current Telegram offset and polling-session state machinery under steipete's recent work, so this is the best available policy owner from history.
